after.description:
Implement the compromise-rate reduction proof consumed by the disruptive-floor gate. This bead must preserve the >=10x reduction claim as a target until fresh red-team artifacts prove it against baseline Node/Bun default posture.

Implementation requirements:
- Define scenario-set identity, baseline posture, FrankenEngine posture, trial count, success criteria for host compromise, and reproducibility commands.
- Compute compromise rate and reduction ratio independently for Node and Bun denominators where applicable.
- Emit machine-readable metric artifact plus human-readable report with uncertainty/coverage notes.

Tests and logging:
- Unit tests cover rate calculation, zero-event boundary handling, denominator mismatch rejection, insufficient trial-count rejection, scenario-set mismatch rejection, and downgrade report generation.
- E2E script validates pass/fail red-team bundles and proves one failing denominator blocks observed >=10x wording.
- Logs include metric_id, scenario_set, baseline_runtime, trial_count, baseline_compromises, candidate_compromises, reduction_ratio, threshold, artifact_hash, command, exit_code, and decision.
